findings.detail: this Windows host has no bash anywhere (portable git usr/bin has 91 files, none named bash*; where.exe bash empty; WSL absent), so the hook exits 127 ('/usr/bin/env: bash') and the first commit attempt did not land. Guard logic is a staged-path regex check; it was executed equivalently in pwsh on the same staged set (vendor_src_changed=0, manifest_changed=0 -> PASS) and whitespace check re-run (exit 0); lint stage had already passed inside lefthook. Commit completed with LEFTHOOK=0 for this one commit only; CI/pre-push owns the real hook run.
